description: List startup funding events detected today, starting at 00:00 UTC. Dates use UTC detection time (created_at), not announcement time. The server recomputes calendar ranges on every request; UTC midnight can change the range between page requests. For a fixed date or custom date range, use get_funding_events with explicit inclusive date_from and date_to (equal for a single day). For rolling windows such as 'last 24 hours', 'last 7 days', or 'last 30 days', query the UTC dates spanning the window with get_funding_events, then filter created_at to the exact timestamps. Date ranges, stage, and amount bounds combine with AND; newest detections first. page starts at 1 (default 1); page_size defaults to 25 (1-100); the offset (page - 1) × page_size must be at most 10000. total counts all matching events, including those beyond the offset limit. To reach older matches, narrow dates with get_funding_events. Pages read the live feed independently; changes between calls can shift offsets, causing repeated or skipped events and changes to total. Each page or retry consumes MCP rate-limit quota per anonymous IP or authenticated account, separate from the public API quota. Successful and failed calls log their arguments and status for usage tracking. Anonymous access is available, with optional Authorization: Bearer <MCP token>. On HTTP 429, retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

amount_max.description: Inclusive maximum round amount in whole units of each event's reported currency. Omit for an open upper bound. Must be at least amount_min when both are supplied. Applying an amount bound excludes events with unknown amounts. Currency conversion is unavailable.

amount_min.description: Inclusive minimum round amount in whole units of each event's reported currency. Omit for an open lower bound. Applying an amount bound excludes events with unknown amounts. Currency conversion is unavailable.

page.description: Page number starting at 1. Increment to fetch the next page with the same filters. The offset (page - 1) × page_size must be at most 10000.

page_size.description: Maximum number of events to return per page.

stage.description: Funding stage: pre_seed, angel, seed, series_a, series_b, series_c, series_d, series_e, other. Case-insensitive. Spaces and hyphens can replace underscores. Blank values are ignored.

name: get_today_funding_events

items.description: Funding events on this page, newest detection first. An empty page returns an empty array.

company_linkedin_url.description: Company LinkedIn page URL. Null when unavailable.

company_name.description: Name of the company receiving funding.

company_website_url.description: Company website or domain. Null when unavailable.

created_at.description: When Tada Signals recorded the funding signal, in UTC.

event_type.description: Type of the signal, always funding.

funding_amount.description: Round amount in whole units of funding_currency. Null when the amount is unknown.

funding_currency.description: Reported currency of funding_amount, such as USD or EUR. Null when the currency is unknown.

funding_stage.description: Reported funding stage, such as seed or series_a. Null when the stage is unknown.

id.description: Unique identifier of the funding signal.

page_size.description: Maximum number of events on this page.

total.description: Number of events matching the filters across all pages.
